notes: PROFINET characterization centers on cyclic timing (send clock, reduction ratio, watchdog), RT/IRT determinism (prioritization, IRT jitter, PTCP sync), and network behaviors (DCP addressing, LLDP topology, MRP recovery). Conformance is established by PI certification per conformance class. The underlying Ethernet PHY is characterized per standard IEEE 802.3.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Cycle time / send clock
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify the IO-CR is sent every send_clock x reduction_ratio (send_clock = 31.25 us x factor).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: RT prioritization
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm RT cyclic frames use EtherType 0x8892 with VLAN PCP = 6 and are prioritized over NRT.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: IRT jitter
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Measure IRT frame timing jitter (< 1 us) under load in the planned red/green schedule.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: PTCP sync accuracy
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify sub-microsecond clock alignment across the sync domain.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Watchdog behavior
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Force a missing frame and confirm the data-hold timeout flags data invalid.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: MRP recovery time
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Break a ring link and measure recovery (<= 200 ms).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: DCP / topology
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify name/IP assignment and LLDP-discovered topology match the plan.
